हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: “A humble son-in-law humiliated and thrown out by his greedy in-laws returns years later as a powerful, self-made man. When secrets explode and tables turn, the family that once insulted him is forced to face the damaad they never valued.”
